Name: Weapon Critical Hit Chance
Description: Weapon Critical Hit Chance Bonus granted from weapon hit.

Name: Weapon Critical Hit Damage
Description: Bonus damage dealt by a weapon after a critical hit.

Name: Weapon Damage
Description: Additional damage dealt by a weapon when it deals damage.

Name: Weapon Multi-Shot Chance
Description: Represents the probability for weapon hits to generate an additional hit. This attribute's value can exceed 100%, with each additional 100% generating another hit.

Name: Headshot Damage
Description: Bonus damage dealt by a weapon after a headshot.

Name: Weapon Blast Damage
Description: The extent to which Blast Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.

Name: Weapon Piercing Damage
Description: The extent to which Piercing Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.

Name: Weapon Shredding Damage
Description: The extent to which Shredding Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.

Name: Max Health
Description: The extent to which Health is increased. A character is downed when their Health reaches 0.

Name: Armor
Description: The amount of bonus Armor. The higher the Agent's Armor, the more Defense they have.

Name: Damage Reduction
Description: Represents the incoming damage reduced from Weapon Damage or Skill Damage. Damage Reduction above 80% will not be applied.

Name: Skill Critical Chance
Description: The chance of skills dealing a critical hit.

Name: Skill Critical Damage
Description: Bonus damage dealt by a skill after a critical hit.

Name: Skill Intensity
Description: The extent to which a skill's effect is enhanced.

Name: Skill Multi-Shot Chance
Description: The chance for skills to deal damage an additional time. Whenever this attribute exceeds 100%, skills deal an extra instance of damage.

Name: Skill Duration
Description: The extent to which Skill Duration is increased.

Name: Skill Radius
Description: The extent to which Skill Radius is expanded.

Name: Skill Cooldown Recovery
Description: The extent to which Skill Cooldown is reduced.

Name: Skill Blast Damage
Description: The extent to which Blast Damage dealt by skills is amplified.

Name: Skill Piercing Damage
Description: The extent to which Piercing Damage dealt by skills is amplified.

Name: Skill Shredding Damage
Description: The extent to which Shredding Damage dealt by skills is amplified.

Name: Received Healing
Description: The extent to which Health is increased when healed by Skills or Medical Kits.

Name: Damage to Elites
Description: Damage Bonus when dealing damage to Elite Enemies.

Name: Signature Ability Charge Efficiency
Description: The extent to which Signature Ability Charge efficiency is accelerated.
